integrity: All claims are supported by a written analytic argument; exhaustive finite enumeration for \(3\le n\le7\) checks the exact joint distribution and moment identities but is not a substitute for infinite proofs. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform simple connected labeled unicyclic graphs only. Strict conditional-mean monotonicity is established, not stochastic ordering of the entire conditional leaf distribution. First-order independence coexists with a nonzero smaller covariance; historical priority requires independent review.
title: Cycle–leaf dependence in uniform connected unicyclic graphs
